title: Milestone 2026.04.40 Retrospective

live_100q_v8.note: RETRO-033 miss #9 — live inference ran but exceeded 45-minute budget; inference latency blocker

live_200q_v7.note: RETRO-038 miss — still blocked on GPU environment; RETRO-053 fix not fully propagated to this pipeline path

new_retro_items.description: Exp 527 (Live 100q Precision v8) timed out at 45 minutes during actual live GPU inference. RETRO-053 was resolved (env_autofix now overrides falsy values), so the env gate is no longer the blocker. The new blocker is inference latency: the live model (Qwen3.6-35B or equivalent) takes too long per question for 100 questions to complete within the 45-minute budget. Fix: (a) reduce n_questions to 25 for first live run, or (b) increase timeout to 90 minutes, or (c) use a smaller model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) for the precision probe. Root cause: batch_timeout_s was set per-batch not per-run; total wall time exceeded budget.

open_retro_items: RETRO-033 [BLOCKING, MISS #9]: Live 100q verify-repair positive result. RETRO-053 resolved (env gate fixed). NEW blocker: Exp 527 timed out at 45 min during live inference. RETRO-055 opened. Fix: reduce n_questions or increase timeout in .41.
RETRO-038: Live 200q VeriCoT+VPRM statistically significant result. Exp 528 deferred (gpu_required). Carries forward to .41 after RETRO-055 resolves.

RETRO-052: GPU1 compute utilization 0%. Exp 529 confirmed model_on_device=True but gpu1_compute_pct=0.0. Explicit cuda:1 routing is insufficient — utilization monitor may not capture short bursts. Deeper profiling needed in .41.
RETRO-054: Batching migration detection found 0/20 scripts. Pattern redesign required. Low priority, carry to .41.
RETRO-055 [NEW, CRITICAL]: Live inference timeout. Exp 527 ran live GPU inference but exceeded 45-min budget. Reduce n_questions or increase timeout. Target: .41.

top_3_bottlenecks: Live inference latency: RETRO-033 missed for 9th consecutive milestone. RETRO-053 fix was correct but Exp 527 hit a new wall — actual model inference too slow for 45-min budget. The env gate was never the only blocker.

GPU1 utilization measurement: Exp 529 shows model_on_device=True but 0% compute. Either the profiling window is too narrow (inference completes before sampling) or compute truly goes to cuda:0. nvidia-smi polling may miss short inference bursts.

EORM/COLD/Potts research branches all showed no improvement in .40: 3 of 5 novel technique experiments returned negative results. Signal: synthetic calibration does not produce actionable precision deltas; live data is required.
top_3_improvements_for_41: RETRO-055 resolution: set n_questions=25 for first live 100q run, or increase timeout to 90 min. This is the single gate before RETRO-033 can close.
LowRankKAEM (Exp 532, 23.7x speedup at k=2) should be wired into the KAN fast-path for .41. Only positive novel result this milestone.
FR-11 live relay (Exp 535, AUC 0.437→0.967 on live fover_442 pairs) is now validated with real data. JEPA v8 should target FR-11 mandatory with live data corpus expanded beyond 57 pairs.
meta_reflection.wall_time_note: Total wall time 55.1 min across 11 experiments. 527 timeout (45 min) dominated. Without timeout: ~10 min — fastest non-trivial milestone in series.
closures_achieved: RETRO-053 CLOSED (Exp 526): env_autofix now correctly overrides CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=0 falsy values. Nine-milestone blocker resolved.
FR-11 live relay achieved (Exp 535): JEPA predictor trained on real fover_442 CoT pairs, AUC 0.437→0.967, checkpoint saved.
LowRankKAEM viable (Exp 532): 23.7x speedup at k=2 with AUROC 0.022 (near-random, confirming synthetic data limitations).
Pipeline tiers wired (Exp 530): Tier-0C and Tier-0D fully integrated.
meta_reflection.retro_033_miss_diagnosis: Miss #9. Previous blocker (RETRO-053: env_autofix treating "0" as set) was resolved in Exp 526. Exp 527 actually executed live GPU inference — confirmed by 45-minute timeout rather than instant deferral. New blocker: inference latency. The model (likely Qwen3.6-35B) takes >27 seconds per question on average, making 100 questions impossible in 45 minutes. RETRO-055 opened. Resolution path: n_questions=25 for first live probe, then scale up once per-question latency is confirmed.
meta_reflection.wall_time_41_rationale: If RETRO-055 uses n_questions=25 with 90s per question = ~37.5 min; other experiments ~5 min each x 6 = 30 min. Total ~60-90 min. With timeout headroom: plan for 90 min.
